## Large Knight Approach
This less-usual approach loses out on territory compared to the small knight approach. But it can reduce the effectiveness of any Black potential on the upper side. (p. 57.)

This approach can also simplify the position, as it generates fewer conventional joseki compared to the more usual approaches. See [Yilun Yang, *2016 Cotsen Open - Yang Yilun 7p vs Liao Guiyong 9p exhibition commentary*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WYO7puzZnrA&t=259s).

[Explanation by Simple Baduk on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/YA4B872faqk?si=ad4hXB-q6QbShP2s)
